annotations.title: Which duties apply to a role and product type

description: Use this when someone describes their role and products and asks what they must do: "I import cleaning products and sell them in my online shop in Austria, which duties apply?", "What does a distributor of construction products need?". Runs ProofPass’s duties check (the same logic as the page /de/pflichten-check): from the role, the product types, the sales channels and the markets it returns the duties that already apply, those adopted with a later date and those expected, each with date, provision and legal sources, plus the link to the same result on the site. It knows the roles manufacturer, importer, distributor and online seller; for a downstream user it says so and derives nothing. Not legal advice. Do not use for a plain list of dates by regulation or product group (use list_deadlines) or for downstream users (it has no branch for them). Not legal advice.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

markets.description: Markets: at (Austria), de (Germany), eu (other EU countries, default)

product_types.description: What is sold: mixture (hazardous substance or mixture), construction_product, consumer_product, battery, machine, radio_equipment, detergent, textile, packaging

name: check_duties
